content.comment_body: Hello, could you let me know how I can download the trial version of the [product_name] software?
You can download the free trial version of [product_name] from this page. The Spanish version is also available. [url]

analysis.insight_summary: The user is requesting guidance on downloading a trial version of [product_name]. The primary UX issue is that users may struggle to find key downloads, highlighting the need for better visibility and navigation.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to quickly locate and download a trial version of [product_name], ideally with language options.
